glitches.affected_subsystem: Sub-Level 2 Heating Manifold & Residential Block B
glitches.anomaly_description: Cast-iron flanged tee junction on the 4-bar low-pressure steam header cracked along hairline casting seam; superheated steam venting at 140°C into Corridor C.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Manifold pressure drop: 4.2 bar -> 1.8 bar; ambient corridor temperature spiked to 58°C; relative humidity 100%.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Isolate isolation valve V-204 with 2-meter extension lever; vent residual steam through bypass stack; fit bolted two-piece clamp collar with graphite packing.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Valery burned his knuckles trying to tighten the flange hot. Reminded him that 140-degree steam is invisible until it strips your skin. Repaired in 45 minutes.

glitches.anomaly_description: Severe acoustic water hammer shockwaves (120 dB) rattling concrete floor slabs; impeller cavitation caused by dissolved nitrogen gas pockets in the deep bedrock aquifer.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Hydraulic line pressure oscillating wildly: 6 bar to 24 bar spikes; pump bearing vibration exceeds 18 mm/s RMS.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Throttle pump intake valve to 60%; open snifting air-bleed cock to restore dampening air cushion; recharge rubber nitrogen bladder accumulator.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Sounded like someone hitting the bedrock with a 50-kilo sledgehammer every three seconds. Dwellers in Block A thought we were taking artillery fire. Balanced in 30 minutes.

glitches.affected_subsystem: Sub-Level 1 Main Electrical Switchyard & Hospital Bus
glitches.anomaly_description: Floating neutral ground fault causing 110V AC leakage onto metallic water pipes and bunk bed frames; incandescent bulbs glowing dim orange while fluorescent tubes flicker at 100 Hz.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Ground-to-neutral potential: 68V AC; leakage current 4.2A through copper sprinkler line; frequency drifting 47.5 Hz to 52.1 Hz.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Switch critical clinic circuits to isolated battery bank; trace grounding busbar to Sub-Level 5 sump pit; drive new 3-meter copper spike into damp gravel strata.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Dr. Vel complained her autoclave was giving nurse Sonya static shocks. Ilya found a loose 35mm ground cable corroded by condensate. Bonded solid now.

glitches.affected_subsystem: Surface Blast Airlock & Main Air Filtration Plenum
glitches.anomaly_description: Pre-filter stage 2 (glass fiber fleece) clogged with damp black soot and irradiated fungal hyphae; static air intake resistance increased 400%, starving ventilation fans.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Differential pressure across filter bank: 1,850 Pa (max allowable 450 Pa); ventilation fan motor drawing 42A (thermal trip imminent); bunker air turnover down 65%.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Don rubber hazmat gear; divert intake through emergency carbon sand scrubber; incinerate contaminated fleece filter in furnace; install fresh oiled fiberglass media.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: The filter fleece was crawling with glowing black slime. Stoker Nadia shoveled the contaminated media directly into the boiler firebox. Pure clean air restored.

glitches.anomaly_description: Vitreous glassy coal clinker fused across the shaking grate bars; airflow choked from underneath, causing incomplete combustion and carbon monoxide backup into the boiler room.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Flue gas CO level: 850 ppm (alarm threshold 50 ppm); steam output collapsed from 1,200 kg/h to 380 kg/h; firebox draft negative 15 Pa.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Engage forced draft blowers; open side inspection doors; manually slice and break glowing 1,100°C clinker with hardened steel pry-bars; recharge bed with low-ash coke.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Nadia worked the slice bar for two hours in front of the white-hot furnace door like a demon. Pried loose a 90-kilo clinker block. Boiler steaming true again.

glitches.affected_subsystem: Sub-Level 5 Blackwater Drainage Basin & Sump Pit
glitches.anomaly_description: Copper ball float switch snagged on rags and grease sediment; automatic macerator pump failed to trigger, causing effluent to rise within 5cm of the lower corridor floor grates.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Sump level gauge: 98% capacity (overflow in 12 minutes); macerator circuit breaker tripped on overcurrent.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Manual override of breaker switch; engage auxiliary air-lift pump; clear macerator cutting teeth of fibrous rags; replace pitted copper float with sealed Teflon bulb.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: The least glamorous job in the apocalypse. Boris drew the short straw and stood in rubber waders to clear the cutter head. He earned two extra beer tokens tonight.

glitches.anomaly_description: Cylinder #4 fuel injector pintle stuck open due to asphaltic gum in reclaimed fuel; heavy metallic knocking, unburned fuel smoking out exhaust, rpm hunting wildly.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Exhaust gas temperature on Cyl #4: 620°C (normal 410°C); generator frequency fluctuating 48 to 53 Hz; voltmeter hunting ±25V.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Switch electrical load to battery buffer; throttle genset to idle; pull stuck injector with slide hammer; lap needle seat with diamond paste; torqued to 85 Nm.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Mikhail heard the knock from three corridors away. Replaced the nozzle in twelve minutes flat before the battery bank dipped below 22V. Master mechanic work.

glitches.anomaly_description: Electromagnetic choke ballast laminated core plates delaminating; emitting a piercing 120 Hz acoustic hum (85 dB) that prevented greenhouse sleep and panicked the laying hens.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Acoustic sensor: 85 dBA continuous hum in Sub-Level 3; ballast case temperature 88°C; poultry egg production dropped 40%.
glitches.emergency_protocol: De-energize lighting branch; vacuum-impregnate magnetic core laminations with baking varnish; mount ballast on vibration-damping neoprene rubber bobbins.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Elena threatened to shoot the ballast with a shotgun if we didn't silence it. The hens laid six eggs within two hours after the hum stopped. Silence is golden.

glitches.anomaly_description: Nitrile chevron packing ring on the 100-ton hydraulic door ram shredded by grit; hydraulic fluid spraying at 180 bar, preventing full hermetic dogging of the 12-ton blast slab.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Hydraulic reservoir level dropped 18 liters; blast gate dogging pressure stalled at 40% (outer seal sealable at 0.05 bar differential only).
glitches.emergency_protocol: Dog safety mechanical locking pawls; depressurize hydraulic loop to accumulator; pull ram cylinder gland nut; pack new reinforced polyurethane chevron rings.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Stepan and Harlan helped me man the manual emergency screw jacks to hold the 12-ton door while we repacked the gland. Zero leaks now at 200 bar test.

glitches.anomaly_description: Deadbeat anchor escapement pallet jewel chipped by concussion from surface blast; clock losing 14 minutes per hour, causing shift change confusion in the canteen.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Chronometer drift: -14 min/h; pendulum amplitude reduced from 4.5 degrees to 1.8 degrees; telegraph time synchronizer out of phase.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Lock pendulum fork; unseat chipped ruby pallet; shellac new synthetic ruby stone into brass arm; calibrate beat using electric strobe pulse generator.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Ilya spent four hours with a tiny gas torch and jeweler's loupe setting the jewel. When the bell struck 12:00 exactly on the radio pulse, everyone cheered.

glitches.anomaly_description: Lithium hydroxide and soda lime granules settled and cracked into void channels; exhaled carbon dioxide bypassing chemical absorbent bed without scrub reaction.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Ambient bunker CO2 concentration climbing: 0.35% -> 1.45% (headache and lethargy threshold); scrubber delta-P dropped from 220 Pa to 40 Pa (fissure bypass).
glitches.emergency_protocol: Switch life support to backup zeolite regenerative beds; empty channeled scrubber canister; reload fresh soda lime with vibratory compaction; test exhaust with Draeger tubes.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Dr. Vel noticed dwellers rubbing their temples and yawning in the clinic. Repacked the beds with fresh granulate. Air feels crisp as mountain snow again.

glitches.anomaly_description: Secondary ethylene glycol coolant loop diluted with condensate water; ice slurry formed inside evaporator shell, blocking refrigerant circulation and warming seed bank.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Vault temperature rising: -4.0°C -> +3.8°C (germination threat threshold for 1938 wheat); glycol loop flow down to 0.4 L/min.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Drain slush from heat exchanger; circulate hot water through defrost jacket; recharge system with 60/40 pure ethylene glycol mix; verify -10°C freeze point on refractometer.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Elena was standing over my shoulder with tears in her eyes watching the temperature gauge. We brought it back down to -5°C within two hours. Not a single seed sprouted.

glitches.anomaly_description: Brass message canister containing emergency blood typing samples stuck at 45-degree elbow in Corridor B vertical riser due to worn felt sealing ring.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Pneumatic line vacuum stalled at -0.8 bar; air blower motor running continuous; message arrival timeout on Clinic terminal.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Reverse blower valving to reverse pressure flow; feed 15-meter spring snake down cleanout hatch; dislodge jammed capsule; replace worn felt driving skirts.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Valery accidentally overloaded the canister with four heavy bronze tokens and a chocolate wrapper. Popped it free with 4 bar air burst. Caught it in a towel.

glitches.anomaly_description: Bi-metallic thermostatic mixing valve wax element ruptured; scalding 80°C hot water pouring through decontamination spray heads with zero cold water tempering.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Shower water discharge temperature: 79.5°C; cold supply check valve stuck shut by calcium carbonate scale deposits.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Shut down decontamination hot supply; disassemble mixing valve housing; pickle brass parts in 10% sulfamic acid descaler; install new wax pellet thermostat cartridge.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Sentry Stepan almost got boiled alive after returning from a surface snow patrol. He leaped out of the stall naked into the cold airlock shouting curses. Fixed before lunch.

glitches.anomaly_description: Dielectric glass tube in the 12,000V silent discharge ozone chamber cracked; electric arc flashing across chassis, tripping main water purification panel and leaking pungent ozone gas.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Ambient ozone concentration: 2.5 ppm (pungent bleach smell); ozone output zero; high-voltage transformer secondary current short-circuit at 450 mA.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Vent ozone room with exhaust fan; de-energize and ground 12kV transformer; replace cracked glass tube with heavy borosilicate spare; verify violet corona glow at 10kV.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Smelled like a thunderstorm trapped inside a steel locker. Replaced the glass tube and tuned the air gap. Artesian water is completely sterile and bacteria-free.

glitches.affected_subsystem: Command Cupola Main Surface Optical Periscope
glitches.anomaly_description: Desiccant cartridge in periscope tube saturated; warm bunker air contacting -25°C surface optics caused thick fogging and frost crystals on the objective prism, blinding observers.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Optical transmission reduced to 8% (opaque white blur); relative humidity inside sealed periscope barrel: 92%.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Purge sealed periscope barrel with 5 bar dry nitrogen gas for fifteen minutes; bake silica gel cartridge in galley oven at 180°C; clean internal prism surfaces with anhydrous ethanol.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Stepan thought a blizzard had rolled in because the periscope screen was white. Just indoor humidity meeting freezing winter steel. Nitrogen purge cleared it sharp as glass.

glitches.affected_subsystem: Sub-Level 2 Galley Waste Line & Kitchen Grease Separator
glitches.anomaly_description: Grease trap baffle plate blocked by congealed lard cakes; anaerobic decomposition produced high-pressure hydrogen sulfide gas pocket that burped into the dining hall at dinner.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: H2S gas detector: 18 ppm in canteen; sewer drain trap siphon sucked dry by negative pressure surge; rotten egg odor.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Evacuate dining hall for twenty minutes; dose grease trap with boiling lye water; skim 25 kg congealed lard cakes into waste drums; refill drain water traps to restore vapor seal.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Oxana was horrified: 'People will think my cabbage soup smells like sulfur!' Poured hot lye down the pipe and cleared the blockage. Air vents cleared in 15 minutes.

glitches.affected_subsystem: Sub-Level 1 Main Lead-Acid DC Storage Battery Bank
glitches.anomaly_description: Cell #22 internal lead plate separator punctured; internal short-circuit generated boiling acid electrolyte and hydrogen gas, threatening explosive chain reaction across all 60 cells.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Cell #22 casing temperature: 94°C (boiling); hydrogen sensor in battery room: 2.8% (explosive limit 4.0%); charging current surged to 120A.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Instantly kill rectifier charging current; activate explosion-proof emergency exhaust fan; isolate and jump cell #22 out of series with heavy copper bypass bar; flood cell with soda slurry.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: A terrifying ten minutes. Ilya and I worked in full acid-proof face masks while the hydrogen meter buzzed. Dropped the jumper across the terminals and pulled cell 22 out. Disaster averted.

glitches.affected_subsystem: Communications Room 1kW Shortwave Transmitter Power Supply
glitches.anomaly_description: Mercury pool vapor pressure spiked during high-power 104.7 MHz broadcast; blue cathode arc flashover shorted 3,000V anode to metal casing, blowing the main ceramic fuses.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Transmitter DC plate voltage: 0V; mercury rectifier bulb temperature: 72°C; mercury cathode emission collapsed.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Allow mercury vapor to condense for 30 minutes; install high-velocity cooling shroud; replace blown 10A sand fuses; slowly ramp plate variac voltage while monitoring blue glow stability.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Taras pushed the transmitter to 1,200 watts trying to reach Vladivostok. The blue glass bulb lit up like lightning and threw a shower of sparks. Taught him to respect mercury.

glitches.affected_subsystem: The Grand Sunken Atrium Master Surface Blast Gate
glitches.anomaly_description: Minor creak in the 40-year-old bronze trunnion hinge bearings of the 30-ton main blast portal during the historic Day 3650 Permanent Opening Ceremony.
glitches.diagnostic_telemetry: Hydraulic ram pressure: 140 bar; opening travel time: 42 seconds; outer air pressure equalized perfectly at 1.013 bar.
glitches.emergency_protocol: Apply graphite tallow grease to hinge fittings; depress the master green pneumatic lever; swing the 30-ton blast gates open wide forever under the morning sun.
glitches.dmitri_shift_note: Master Oleg and I pumped the last squirt of grease into the trunnion fittings. The massive steel doors rolled back with a deep, silent glide. Sunlight flooded forty meters down the stairwell. All maintenance tickets permanently closed.
